descriptionHints: A fired clay mould for amulet-making.
acquisitionHints: Made through Crafting at level 1 at a fire using Imprinted Amulet Mould x1.
useHints: Used for matching amulet jewelry recipes after the amulet mould unlock. Complete Moulds of the Trade for Elira Gemhand to earn all three unlocks.

descriptionHints: A fired clay mould for ring-making.
acquisitionHints: Made through Crafting at level 1 at a fire using Imprinted Ring Mould x1.
useHints: Used for matching ring jewelry recipes after the ring mould unlock. Complete Moulds of the Trade for Elira Gemhand to earn all three unlocks.

descriptionHints: A fired clay mould for tiara-making.
acquisitionHints: Made through Crafting at level 1 at a fire using Imprinted Tiara Mould x1.
useHints: Used for matching tiara jewelry recipes after the tiara mould unlock. Complete Moulds of the Trade for Elira Gemhand to earn all three unlocks.

descriptionHints: Currency used to buy items from merchants.
acquisitionHints: Earn Coins by selling items, collecting enemy drops, or completing quests such as Hides of the Frontier.
useHints: Spend Coins at merchants. Check stock and trade access before planning a purchase.

descriptionHints: Ashes left by a burnt-out fire.
acquisitionHints: Take the Ashes that appear on the ground when a Firemaking fire burns out.
useHints: Ashes have no recipe use in the current game.

descriptionHints: Soft clay used to imprint jewelry moulds.
acquisitionHints: Use Clay on water at Crafting level 1.
useHints: Near a crafting bench, use Soft Clay on a Borrowed Ring, Borrowed Amulet, or Borrowed Tiara to make the matching imprinted mould. Fire the imprinted mould before using it for jewelry.

descriptionHints: A basic firemaking tool used to ignite logs.
acquisitionHints: Stocked by general stores in Main Overworld.
useHints: Used to light logs for Firemaking.
